root_cause_criterion.criterion: Before the null-terminated boolean fast path can execute `std::memcpy(&c, it, 5)`, the copied span end `it + 5` must stay within `end`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable non-padded boolean parser relies on a four-byte minimum check and then unconditionally copies five bytes. In the crashing run the third array element reaches this block with only four in-span bytes left, so the copied span endpoint `it + 5` lands one byte past `end`. The fixed program changes the corresponding prefix copy to four bytes, so the copied span ends at `end` instead of beyond it.

nodes.state: At the vulnerable `std::memcpy(&c, it, 5)` sink, the last copied byte address `it + 4` equals `end`, so the copy consumes the first byte beyond the parser span.

edges.relation: The `++it` after the second comma in the array loop produces the same cursor value later passed as the source pointer to the null-terminated boolean fast-path copy.
